rationale: A better models Forth words as executable stack transformations and resolves every definition token at definition time, correctly preserving prior meanings even when built-ins are later redefined. Its shared operand helpers and sentinel errors also reduce duplication and avoid mutating the stack before a divide-by-zero check. B is cleanly decomposed, but its expansion freezes only user-defined words; built-in tokens remain dynamically resolved, so a previously defined word can silently change behavior after a built-in is redefined.
